items.q: the Ethnic Variations on a Theme for [sic: of] Paganini, which I wrote for Ruggiero Ricci.

ctx.x: Paul Freeman conducting. There’s a – of the sonatas, there’s a piece for clarinet, a sonata for clarinet which also has a version for flute and piano, a version for clarinet and organ, a version for violin and piano, and a version for – I guess that’s it. Of the recordings, there’s a duet for alto saxophone[s] which is recorded by a guy named Takashi Yonekura on an album called After the Rain. It’s in Japan, in Tokyo. [There is] a duet for clarinet and cello which has not been recorded yet, and the Ethnic…
